title: The Hungry Winter
author: Bram Marchetti
blurb: Lior Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
